pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with moderately smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries due to low resolution. Spatial area is variable, with larger and more elongated geometries visible on the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes primarily connect three to four pathways. Line thickness is narrow and remains relatively uniform across the visible neck and shoulder segments.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck, creating a textured edge against the background.
